producer_blindness: The producer brief excludes this oracle directory.

criteria.ambitious_interaction: Defines a concrete rich compact-to-expanded activity experience that preserves the existing note journey and does not fabricate unsupported status detail.
criteria.three_ui_views: Covers component/state contracts, human and machine interaction/lifecycle state, and preserved or intentional visual-system evolution.
criteria.gap_and_options: Identifies the current reusable motion/component gap and compares actual DOM/CSS evolution, unverified target-native API, and non-assumed framework/package paths.
criteria.conditional_adoption: Does not claim View Transitions or a package is available; assigns a target-compatible probe/decision before adoption and retains a safe fallback.
criteria.decision_economics: States assumption-bound rough effort, user benefit, maintenance/performance/accessibility/target tradeoffs, and no duplicate system/harness plan.
criteria.async_integrity: Addresses identity, revisions, visible/foreground recovery, state cue truthfulness, stale/error persistence, coalescing, focus, interruption, and reduced motion.

limits: This oracle assesses only written plan artifacts and persisted navigator structure. It cannot establish target capability, component behavior, browser evidence, package fit, or deployment.
